result.lens: CONFABULATION (the no-confab moat crux): does the per-hop cleanup/scan abstain on an unsupported hop, or can it hand the chain a nearest-neighbour filler that is treated as a valid fact?

findings.failure_mode: The abstain gate is EXACT STRING EQUALITY of the argmax-decoded cue word, NOT a similarity threshold or a top1/top2 margin. cleanup itself NEVER returns None — it always returns the nearest codebook entry.
findings.mechanism: _cleanup (rf_phasor_composer.py:658-663) is a bare argmax: `sims=[mean cos(rec, concept_w) for w in words]; return words[argmax(sims)]` — no floor, no None. _cleanup_all (700-710) is the batched twin: `sims=(rec_z @ conj(cb).T).real; return [words[argmax_j] ...]` — again argmax only. The ONLY thing that produces None is _scan_first_match (712-721): for each cue role it decodes every stored composite (`words=_cleanup_all(_unbind_all_phases(comps, role))`) then `mask &= (w == val)`; `return int(idx[0]) if len(idx) else None`. So None fires iff NO stored fact's decoded cue roles ALL string-equal the query. The moat is therefore STRUCTURAL (scan over truly-stored facts + exact-string cue match), NOT confidence-based. This is safe for a cue word that is not in the codebook at all (argmax can only emit an in-vocab word, so an out-of-vocab agent can never be matched — genuinely safe). But once the cue word IS in the codebook (always true inside a compositional chain, where every concept is in-vocab) the gate depends entirely on the decode landing on the exact query string, with no minimum-similarity requirement.
findings.manifests_as: A confident answer to 'what does X <rel>?' whenever a DIFFERENT stored fact's cue-role crosstalk-decodes onto X — presented as fact with no low-confidence signal, because the argmax always returns something and the gate never inspects HOW close the match was.
findings.mitigation: Put a confidence floor on the decision path. The needed statistic already exists but is trace-only: _cleanup_all_score_stats (724-755) computes winner_score_raw (mean-cos) and margin (top-runner). In _scan_first_match, replace the bare `w == val` mask with `w == val AND winner_score_raw >= tau AND margin >= delta`, so a low-confidence or ambiguous cue decode abstains (returns None) instead of matching. Calibrate tau/delta from the same-vs-different distribution the code already knows how to build (_calibrate_pe_labile, 870-889, is the template).

findings.failure_mode: A WRONG-but-close fact CAN pass the cue gate and be propagated as a valid hop — a true false positive — at ANY similarity, because there is no minimum-similarity floor.
findings.mechanism: For query_patient(agent, action) the fast path calls _scan_first_match(agent=agent, action=action) (line 1004). A stored fact (A, act, P) with A != agent is a false-match candidate: unbinding its 'agent' role recovers A's phasor plus FHRR crosstalk from the other bound terms (action/patient, +attribute/attribute2/polarity when present — store() at 835-851 bundles up to 5-6 terms, each extra bind raising crosstalk). If that noisy recovery's argmax (line 710) coincidentally equals the queried `agent` string AND the action role likewise decodes to `action`, then mask stays True and the fact matches. query_patient then returns that fact's patient (1010-1012) — a fabricated 'agent <rel> patient' that was never stored. Because the gate is `w == val` with no floor, the false match passes even if the winning mean-cos is ~0.05: similarity is irrelevant, only that the argmax string equals the cue. Sharding does not fix this (it only shrinks the candidate set to the ~K/S facts whose agent hash-collides into the queried shard), and the existing '0 confabulations' evidence does NOT cover it — the soak moat test (_knowledge_scale_flip_soak.py:174-188, _knowledge_core_bundle_soak.py) only probes UNSTORED cues (unknown agents / an action the agent never has), which abstain structurally; it never stresses in-vocab near-miss cues where crosstalk can land on the query word.
findings.manifests_as: The reasoning route answers 'wolf eats grass' (a fact assembled from a real 'deer eat grass' whose agent role mis-decoded to 'wolf') for a subject the store holds no eating fact about — indistinguishable from a real recall.
findings.mitigation: Same floor-and-margin gate as finding 1, applied to EVERY cue role in _scan_first_match. Additionally reduce the crosstalk that drives the false decode: the LTM builds at D=128 (tiered_fact_store.py:65 build_ltm_from_facts default D=128; developed_brain_io.py:369 ltm_D=128) — characterize the per-role cue-decode error rate at the deployed D and vocab/fact scale (15k), and raise D if the measured near-miss false-positive rate is nonzero, since faithfulness (not speed) is the standard.

findings.failure_mode: Even a TRULY-matched fact can return the WRONG patient (a decode error on the answer role), which the chain then propagates — the answer decode has NO gate at all and can never abstain.
findings.mechanism: After a cue match, query_patient renders the answer via _render->_cleanup (542-557) and attribute unbinds via self.unbind->_cleanup (1010-1012, 1028) — all pure argmax with no None path. So a matched (but crosstalk-degraded) fact ALWAYS emits a concrete patient string; if the patient-role recovery's argmax is a neighbour of the true stored patient, the returned word is wrong yet asserted as fact. In query_chain (1034-1047) that wrong patient becomes the next hop's cue and routes (ShardedPhasorStore.query_patient, 108-109) to the wrong shard, sending the remainder of the chain down a fabricated-but-'real' branch that will NOT abstain (it is chasing a genuine, wrongly-identified concept).
findings.manifests_as: 'what does the wolf's prey eat?' returns a real animal that is the wrong prey's diet, because hop 1 recovered the wrong prey word; no confidence signal marks the substitution.
findings.mitigation: Gate the answer decode too: compute the winner_score_raw/margin for the patient (and attribute) roles (the trace path already does this at 1015-1022 via _cleanup_all_score_stats) and return None (abstain) when below the floor, rather than emitting the nearest word. An honest 'I'm not sure' is the deliverable; a confident wrong recall is the failure.

findings.failure_mode: Per-hop false-positive/decode-error probability COMPOUNDS multiplicatively over a multi-hop chain, and query_chain returns NO end-to-end confidence — only the bare terminal concept or None.
findings.mechanism: query_chain (rf_phasor_composer.py:1034-1047 and ShardedPhasorStore.py:117-125) loops query_patient per hop and returns `x` (the terminal string) or None. The docstring's claim that 'the cleanup re-discretizes the intermediate concept each hop, so retrieval error does NOT compound' (1039-1041) is true only for PHASE NOISE (each hop restarts from a clean codebook phasor) — it does NOT stop the per-hop ERROR PROBABILITY from compounding: for H hops each independently correct with prob (1-p), P(clean chain) ~ (1-p)^H, so a 4-hop chain at p=0.05/hop is ~0.81 correct / ~0.19 silently wrong. Crucially a false hop does not abstain (findings 2-3), so the chain returns a confident wrong terminal. No margin/product-of-confidences is aggregated or returned, so the handler cannot decline a low-confidence chain.
findings.manifests_as: Longer compositional questions ('what does the wolf's prey's prey eat?') return confident answers whose correctness silently degrades with hop count, with nothing in the return value indicating lower confidence.
findings.mitigation: Thread a confidence through query_chain: have query_patient also return the min cue-margin and answer-margin for the hop, aggregate across hops (min or product), and return (terminal, confidence). The handler declines/hedges below a threshold. Combined with the per-hop floor (findings 1-2), this converts a silent wrong chain into an explicit abstain.

findings.failure_mode: chain_of_thought self-selects the relation per hop by learned association strength, GOAL-BLIND — for an EXPLICIT compositional question it can chase a different relation than the one asked and return a real-but-off-question answer that no moat flags.
findings.mechanism: _select_next_relation (1063-1076) picks `max(sorted(cands), key=cands.get)` over the concept's relations by co-occurrence count (_relation_assoc, 1050-1061) with NO reference to the question's goal — the `goal` arg to chain_of_thought (1078-1113) only stops the loop when the terminal happens to equal it, it does not steer relation choice. So for 'what does the wolf's prey eat?' (relations GIVEN: prey-of, eat) chain_of_thought may instead chase whatever relation wolf co-occurs with most (e.g. 'hunt'/'run'), producing a genuinely-stored but wrong-question answer. This is not a fabricated fact, but it is an answer NOT backed by the asked question, and the abstain path (dead-end only, 1103/1106) never fires because a strong wrong relation is available.
findings.manifests_as: An explicit multi-hop question is answered by a different chain than the one asked — confidently and topically plausibly — with no signal that the brain substituted its own relations.
findings.mitigation: Route explicit compositional questions through query_chain(cue, [explicit actions]) NOT chain_of_thought: query_chain forces the exact asked relations, so a missing asked hop ABSTAINS (query_patient->None) instead of being replaced by an available-but-unasked relation. Reserve chain_of_thought for genuinely open-ended 'free association' turns where no relation list is given. This is strictly moat-safer for the plan's target ('what does the wolf's prey eat?'), since the relations are supplied by the parse.

result.key_uncertainty: The per-hop cue-decode FALSE-POSITIVE rate at the DEPLOYED scale is unmeasured. The existing '0 confabulations' evidence (_knowledge_scale_flip_soak.py:174-188 and _knowledge_core_bundle_soak.py) only probes UNSTORED cues that abstain structurally; it never stresses in-vocab NEAR-MISS cues where FHRR bundling crosstalk can push a stored fact's cue-role argmax onto the queried word (findings 1-2). Before the reasoning route is trusted moat-clean, the implementer must measure, at the production LTM's D=128 and the 15k-fact / real vocab scale, the rate at which query_patient returns a fact for a subject that has no such fact (i.e., a wrong-agent fact whose agent+action both crosstalk-decode onto the query) and the per-hop wrong-patient rate — the single number that determines whether the argmax-with-no-floor gate is actually safe or merely safe on the cues the soak happened to pick.

result.lens: MOAT-BYPASS / handler integration: how /api/brain-chat abstains + gates a single-fact recall, and where a compositional chain-route branch would let derived content skip those gates.

findings.failure_mode: A chain answer routed via a DIRECT composer.query_chain / ShardedPhasorStore.query_chain call bypasses the entire GNW consensus/deliberation gate stack that every single-fact answer passes through. Those gates only ADD abstains a single-fact recall would otherwise not make — most importantly the multi-answer CONFLICT abstain.
findings.mechanism: The 2-organ (surprise), 3-organ (comprehension veto), single-hop deliberation (conflict), and multistep gates are all installed as wrappers around chat.gate (webapp/server.py:3900-3984 install them; gnw_bus_shadow.install_bus_gate sets `orig_gate = chat.gate; chat.gate = _bus_gate` at gnw_bus_shadow.py:427-448; the others follow the same pattern and read chat.inner.composer). query_chain / chain_of_thought / query_patient live ONE LEVEL BELOW on chat.inner.composer (rf_phasor_composer.py:1034 / sharded_phasor_store.py:117) and are NOT wrapped. The plan text 'route to ShardedPhasorStore.query_chain / chain_of_thought' is a direct composer-level call, so none of those wrappers run. Critically, gnw_deliberation.all_candidate_patients (gnw_deliberation.py:122-134) is what ABSTAINS when >=2 distinct patients are stored under the SAME (agent, action); query_chain's per-hop query_patient instead silently takes _scan_first_match's FIRST match (rf_phasor_composer.py:721 `return int(idx[0])`).
findings.code_location: webapp/server.py:3900-3984 (gate wrappers) vs sharded_phasor_store.py:117-125 query_chain / rf_phasor_composer.py:994-1032 query_patient; conflict gate gnw_deliberation.py:122-134
findings.manifests_as: On a hop whose (agent, action) has two stored answers (e.g. 'wolf eat' -> both 'deer' and 'sheep' stored), the single-hop path would say 'I don't know about that' (deliberation conflict abstain), but the chain confidently marches through the arbitrary first-match and emits one definite multi-hop conclusion — a confident wrong answer exactly where the moat's added gates were designed to withhold.
findings.mitigation: Do not call composer.query_chain directly. Drive each hop THROUGH chat.gate (so every hop inherits the bus/comprehension/deliberation consensus + conflict abstain), or replicate the deliberation conflict check per hop (all_candidate_patients) and abstain the whole chain if any hop is multi-valued. Treat the chain as N gated single-hops, not one raw composer call.

findings.failure_mode: The #129 source-provenance honesty wire hardcodes PROVENANCE_PERCEIVED, so a DERIVED multi-hop conclusion routed through it would be framed as directly perceived/taught — the exact inverse of the plan's own goal #3 ('I derived this from X and Y'). This is a provenance LIE, not just a missing feature.
findings.mechanism: webapp/server.py:5164-5175 unconditionally calls `_sp_mon.encode_fact(_sp_key, PROVENANCE_PERCEIVED)` then `provenance_framed_text('what_does', answer, label)`. provenance_framed_text leaves a PERCEIVED label UNCHANGED and only flags GENERATED (source_provenance_honesty.py:120-134; labels at :45-47 are 'perceived'/'generated'). The guarding comment at server.py:5154-5156 asserts 'gate() only ever returns a DIRECTLY-STORED fact (never a composed multi-hop inference)' — a chain route breaks that invariant. It is ALREADY broken in latent form: the default-ON multistep chase emits a composed terminal by mutating the SVO patient (gnw_multistep_deliberation.py:209-211 `out[2] = terminal`), which flows back through this same PERCEIVED wire on a chase-form question.
findings.manifests_as: 'What does the wolf's prey eat?' -> 'The wolf's prey eats grass.' rendered with full confidence and, under the honesty organ, an asserted-as-perceived framing — the brain claiming it was TOLD a fact it actually inferred. #129 is currently default-off so it does not fire in prod today, but the plan's honest-derivation requirement is precisely what must turn it on, and reusing this wire verbatim inverts it.
findings.mitigation: For a chain/derived answer, encode PROVENANCE_GENERATED (not PERCEIVED) so provenance_framed_text emits the 'my own inference' framing, and surface the supporting hop-facts so the reply can literally say 'I derived this from <fact1> and <fact2>'. Also fix the now-false invariant comment at server.py:5154-5156.

findings.failure_mode: The chain terminal is a DERIVED proposition that the existing render + VERIFY treats as a genuine stored fact, so 'verified: true' and 'recalled_svo' assert a fact that was never stored.
findings.mechanism: The single-fact path renders gate_svo then sets `verified = '[unverified render' not in answer` (server.py:5148-5150). VERIFY (brain_chat_tui.py:791 _verify) only checks that the SURFACE re-parses back to gate_svo — NOT that gate_svo is a stored fact. A chain route that emits a synthesized triple (as the multistep gate does: gnw_multistep_deliberation.py:209-211 sets patient=terminal on the base SVO) yields e.g. [wolf, eat, grass], which renders and re-parses cleanly -> verified=True, recalled_svo=[wolf,eat,grass], abstained=False — indistinguishable in the API from a directly-recalled fact even though only [deer,eat,grass] is stored.
findings.manifests_as: The response labels a composed inference as a verified recalled fact. Downstream consumers then treat it as ground truth: the episodic Hook-B store writes note_topic(gate_svo[0]) (server.py:5181-5184) and the discourse-WM referent write (brain_chat_tui.py:380-382) both ingest the synthesized SVO as if perceived, polluting session memory with a fact the brain never learned.
findings.mitigation: Give a derived answer a distinct shape: abstained=False but recalled_svo=None (or a `derived_from: [[a,v,p]...]` list of the real hop-facts) and a `derived: true` flag; do not feed the synthesized terminal SVO into the episodic store / discourse WM as a perceived fact. Verify each HOP-fact (each is stored) rather than the composed terminal.

findings.failure_mode: Lemmatizing only the recall/query path (not the stored facts) moves the exact-string-equality surface the moat keys on, silently converting genuine matches to over-abstains and, on homographs, matching the WRONG stored fact.
findings.mechanism: The abstain is NOT a cleanup confidence threshold — _cleanup always returns the nearest codebook word (rf_phasor_composer.py:658-663, plain argmax, no threshold). The moat is exact string equality between the cleaned-up RECOVERED stored value and the QUERY value inside _scan_first_match (rf_phasor_composer.py:712-721: `mask &= (w == val)`). So the whole abstain hinges on the query token string. Lemmatizing the query cue ('eats'->'eat', 'wolves'->'wolf') while facts are stored un-lemmatized shifts one side of that `==`; a homograph lemma collapse ('left' dir vs 'left' past, 'saw' tool vs past-of-see) maps two concepts to one key.
findings.manifests_as: Either the brain abstains on facts it actually holds (lemmatized query never string-equals the un-lemmatized stored role) — a silent recall regression across every path (single-fact, chain, rich) — or, on a homograph, it confidently returns a real-but-wrong stored fact.
findings.mitigation: Lemmatize BOTH sides consistently — normalize role tokens at STORE time (or normalize both query and stored roles through the same lemmatizer at compare time) so the `==` gate compares like-for-like; keep a homograph guard (don't collapse distinct stored senses to one lemma). Add a determinism/parity check that a lemmatized query still matches its own stored fact.

findings.failure_mode: A new chain-branch that returns its own JSONResponse (mirroring the ~12 organ short-circuits) would bypass the whole response tail — provenance framing, metacog hedge, affect/curiosity — and can be pre-empted or mis-handled by an earlier short-circuit (causal, comprehension-repair, or _maybe_acquire teaching the question as a fact).
findings.mechanism: The handler runs a long ordered chain of short-circuit classes each returning early (self-initiate 4065-4081, feel-query 4139-4146, open-ended 4162-4201, pmem-formation 4362-4368, episodic-referential 4405-4443, worldmodel/causal 4447+). Only the single-fact (5138-5321) and rich (4972-5136) tails apply provenance/metacog/verify. A chain branch placed as another early-return inherits none of that and must re-implement honesty itself. Placement also matters: chat.gate itself calls _maybe_acquire FIRST (brain_chat_tui.py:339-341) — an SVO-shaped input is TAUGHT; a genuine question is safe, but a mis-shaped compositional string could be ingested rather than answered.
findings.code_location: webapp/server.py:4044-4960 (short-circuit ladder) vs 5138-5321 (single-fact tail with provenance/metacog); brain_chat_tui.py:339-341 _maybe_acquire in gate()
findings.manifests_as: A compositional question either gets swallowed by an earlier organ (e.g. the causal why/what-if or comprehension-repair class) and never reaches the chain, or the chain answer is spoken raw — no provenance/derived framing, no low-confidence hedge — so its honesty depends entirely on branch-local code that duplicates (and can drift from) the tail's gates.
findings.mitigation: Prefer routing the chain THROUGH the shared single-fact/rich tail (so provenance + metacog + verify apply once) over a bespoke early-return; if an early-return is required, explicitly re-apply the provenance (GENERATED) + metacog framing in the branch. Scope the chase trigger precisely so it fires only on genuine compositional forms and is ordered after the disjoint organ classes it must not steal from.

findings.failure_mode: SAFE-BY-CONSTRUCTION (report the non-hole): the per-hop no-confab moat IS preserved by query_chain — the 'cleanup always returns the nearest vector' danger does not by itself breach the abstain, because the abstain is exact-string-equality-gated, not cleanup-threshold-gated.
findings.mechanism: query_chain returns None the moment any hop's query_patient returns None (sharded_phasor_store.py:117-125; rf_phasor_composer.py:1034-1047). query_patient's None comes from _scan_first_match (rf_phasor_composer.py:712-721), which cleans up the RECOVERED STORED role value and compares it by exact `==` to the QUERY. Because the nearest-neighbour fill is applied to recover a stored value and then matched for equality against the cue, a cleanup that 'always returns something' cannot fabricate a matching hop unless a genuinely-stored fact decodes to the queried (agent, action) pair. Sharding further protects this by keeping per-shard K small (high SNR), which is the whole design intent (sharded_phasor_store.py:24). The residual is purely probabilistic: at large K/V an unbind can mis-clean a stored role to coincidentally equal the cue (a false hop), and the chain LAUNDERS one false hop into a fluent multi-hop conclusion (each intermediate is re-discretised to a clean codebook word, so the wrong concept looks valid downstream).
findings.manifests_as: For a truly unknown subject/relation the chain abstains cleanly (the moat holds at every hop). The only confabulation channel is a rare SNR-driven false single-hop match that the chain then extends — mitigated, not eliminated, by keeping per-shard K small.
findings.mitigation: Keep per-shard occupancy bounded (monitor ShardedPhasorStore.load_balance for hot subjects) and, for chain answers specifically, gate on the per-hop cleanup CONFIDENCE (the _cleanup_all_score_stats margin, rf_phasor_composer.py:724-755, already computed on the trace path) — abstain a hop whose winner/runner margin is thin, so a low-SNR false hop cannot seed the chain.

result.key_uncertainty: Whether the implementer will drive the chain THROUGH chat.gate per hop (inheriting the GNW consensus + deliberation conflict-abstain, and reaching the response tail's provenance/metacog framing) or call composer/ShardedPhasorStore.query_chain DIRECTLY as the plan's wording literally says. The plan phrasing ('route ... to ShardedPhasorStore.query_chain / chain_of_thought') reads as a direct composer-level call, which is the bypass that makes findings 1-3 fire; if instead each hop is a gated single-hop plus PROVENANCE_GENERATED framing, most of the risk collapses. This one routing decision — direct composer call vs gated-hop-through-chat.gate with derived-provenance — determines whether the chain is a moat bypass or safe.

findings.failure_mode: Missed-compositional under-route: the live question→(agent,action) extractor unconditionally truncates to the first two content words, so any compositional/relational question (≥3 content words after stopword strip) has its real verb/relation silently dropped and is misparsed as an atomic single-hop cue.
findings.mechanism: `_extract_route` strips a fixed stopword set (which includes "of" and does NOT split off possessive "'s") to get `content`, then (when a parser is present and len(content)>=2) calls `_neural_question_parse(content)`, which builds `padded = [content[0], content[1], "__q__"]` and reads BridgeParser.role_of(0..2) over just those three slots — content[2] and beyond are never read at all. For "what does the wolf's prey eat?": tokens survive stripping as content=["wolf's","prey","eat"]; only "wolf's"->agent, "prey"->action are used, and the real verb "eat" is discarded. query_patient("wolf's","prey") matches no stored fact -> honest abstain, exactly the abstain seen in the 2026-08-25 diagnostic transcript. Any compositional detector layered ON TOP of this function without fixing the truncation gains nothing: by the time detection would run, the 3rd+ content word is already gone.
findings.code_location: research/runners/brain_chat_tui.py:640-662 (_neural_question_parse, esp. line 652 `padded = [content[0], content[1], "__q__"]`) and :688-729 (_extract_route, esp. line 697 the `_STOP` set including "of" with no possessive-splitting)
findings.manifests_as: A compositional question either (a) cleanly abstains ("I don't know about that") when the truncated 2-word cue matches nothing — moat-safe but silently wrong — or (b) worse, accidentally MATCHES the first hop's real stored fact and returns it as if it answered the whole question: the diagnostic's "the wolf hunts the deer and the deer eats grass; so what does what the wolf hunts eat?" → "The wolf huntses deer." (content[0]/content[1] = "wolf"/"hunts" happens to be a real taught fact, so query_patient truthfully returns "deer" — a genuinely stored answer, but to only the FIRST hop, never advancing to "eat"/"grass"). This is moat-safe (nothing is fabricated) but presents a confidently wrong-scoped answer instead of either the correct chained answer or a clean abstain.
findings.mitigation: Run compositional detection + relation-sequence extraction on the FULL stopword-stripped content list (not content[0:2]) and BEFORE `_extract_route`'s two-word collapse, so the possessive marker and every clause verb survive long enough to be parsed; treat "'s" and "of" as structural relation markers rather than deleting them in the stopword pass.

findings.failure_mode: Mis-parsed relation sequence: there is no existing lexicon mapping an English relation NOUN ("prey", "predator", "owner") to the stored predicate/verb token it names, so any compositional shape that expresses a hop as a nominalized relation rather than a repeated verb cannot be decomposed into a `query_chain` action list at all.
findings.mechanism: The only two role/keyword lexicons in the live pipeline are `_QUESTION_SYNONYMS` (brain_chat_tui.py) — self-identity keyword variants like "learn"->"learns", scoped to the QuestionRouter's self-alias fallback — and `WH_ROLE_CANDIDATES`/`WH_MULTIWORD` (wh_question_parser.py) — which map wh-WORDS (who/what/where) to THEMATIC ROLES (agent/patient/GOAL), not to domain relation nouns. Neither contains, nor is structured to contain, an entry translating "prey" -> the stored verb "hunts" (inverse) / "eaten by", or "predator" -> "hunts" (forward). Additionally `wh_question_parser.py`'s own regexes (`_WH_AUX_RE`, `_WH_SUBJ_RE`) capture agent/verb as single `\w+` tokens with no possessive/genitive support, so "wolf's" fails the regex outright (apostrophe breaks `\w+`) — and this module is not even imported by webapp/server.py or brain_chat_tui.py today, so it isn't part of the live routing path to build on.
findings.code_location: research/runners/brain_chat_tui.py:154-167 (_QUESTION_SYNONYMS — wrong domain) and research/runners/wh_question_parser.py:44-76 (WH_ROLE_CANDIDATES / _WH_AUX_RE — thematic roles only, single-token agent/verb, no possessive; confirmed unused by webapp/server.py or brain_chat_tui.py via grep)
findings.manifests_as: A compositional question phrased with a relation NOUN instead of a repeated verb (the task prompt's own worked example, "what does the wolf's prey eat?") cannot be decomposed into `query_chain(cue, ["hunts","eats"])` without a brand-new, hand-authored noun->verb relation lexicon; any relation noun not in that closed table falls through to under-route (finding 1) rather than raising a visible error, so coverage gaps are invisible without an explicit test panel naming every intended relation noun.
findings.mitigation: Build and version an explicit, closed relation-noun→stored-verb table (e.g. prey->hunts(inverse), predator->hunts, offspring->parent-of(inverse)) as its own auditable artifact (mirroring how `WH_ROLE_CANDIDATES` and FRAME_ROLES are already explicit hand-authored tables in this codebase), and have the detector fail closed (pass through to the existing single-hop path) on any relation word not in the table rather than guessing.

findings.failure_mode: False-positive routing: a simple single-hop question with modifiers (adjectives, extra determiners) can present the same surface signal (word count > 2) that a naive compositional detector would use to trigger routing, sending an ordinary question down the chain path and changing its answer/latency.
findings.mechanism: The current `_STOP` set (brain_chat_tui.py:696-698) does not remove adjectives, so "what does the big hungry wolf eat?" strips to content=["big","hungry","wolf","eat"] — 4 content words, the same length signature a >=3-content-word compositional trigger would fire on — yet this is a plain single-hop question. (Illustrating the same fragility, the CURRENT code already mis-extracts this case independent of the reasoning-route plan: `_neural_question_parse` reads only content[0]/content[1] = "big"/"hungry" as (agent, action), a pre-existing bug this plan's detector must not compound.) A content-word-COUNT heuristic therefore cannot reliably distinguish "long because of modifiers" from "long because it's multi-hop."

findings.manifests_as: An ordinary modifier-bearing recall question gets detoured into the multi-hop chain engine, either abstaining where the simple path would have answered correctly, or returning a different (chain-terminal) answer than the user's actual single-hop question asked for — a regression on previously-working simple questions.
findings.mitigation: Gate the compositional detector on an unambiguous STRUCTURAL marker (a genitive 's attached to the wh-subject, or a member of the closed relation-noun table from finding 2) rather than word count, and default to the existing single-hop path whenever the structural marker is absent or ambiguous — exactly the pattern `webapp/gnw_multistep_deliberation.py`'s `detect_chase` already uses safely for its own (different) chase-marker detection.

findings.failure_mode: Honesty/emergence-bar declaration (not a functional defect): the entire question→(agent,action) comprehension pipeline this plan extends is host Python string/token/regex code, not a substrate capability, and the one piece already branded "neural"/"on-brain" (BridgeParser) contributes no linguistic structure — it just executes a hardcoded position→role convention on spiking neurons.
findings.mechanism: `BridgeParser.parse` (research/runners/brain_conversational_agent.py:163-167) asserts `len(words)==3` and reads `role_of(position, voice)` for each fixed slot; the mapping itself is a Hebbian-trained readout of the hardcoded ground truth `_GT = {0:"agent",1:"patient",2:"action",...}` (line 25) — i.e. "position 0 is always the agent in active voice" is baked into the training targets, not discovered. `_neural_question_parse` (brain_chat_tui.py:640-662) merely pads whatever two content words survived the host stopword-strip into this fixed 3-slot template and reads back which slot each occupies — a spiking execution of a host-decided positional convention, not compositional-structure recognition. Any new logic this plan adds (detecting a possessive/relational surface form, mapping a relation noun to a stored verb, ordering the hop sequence for query_chain) will necessarily be additional host Python — there is no substrate mechanism in this codebase that discovers syntactic/relational structure from raw text.
findings.manifests_as: No incorrect behavior by itself — this is a required declaration under the project's brain-based-only standard: the compositional-question comprehension layer is comprehension-boundary host scaffolding (consistent with the project's own stated boundary that comprehension parsing may be host-side while recall/cognition stays substrate), and should be labeled as such rather than folded into the "neuralized parser" framing from board item #43, which could otherwise be read as claiming the compositional detection itself is emergent.
findings.mitigation: Document the new compositional detector + relation-lexicon explicitly as host comprehension scaffolding (same category as `_definitional_copula_route`'s regex or `WH_ROLE_CANDIDATES`), leaving `chain_of_thought`/`query_chain`'s spiking recall + no-confab abstain as the declared substrate capability being invoked.

findings.failure_mode: None identified — verified safe by construction: query_chain/chain_of_thought's reliance on query_patient returning None for an unstored hop is NOT undermined by a nearest-neighbour-always-returns-something cleanup, because the match decision is a string-equality comparison against a REAL stored composite's own decoded content, never a similarity threshold on the cue itself.
findings.mechanism: `_scan_first_match` (rf_phasor_composer.py:712-721) and the non-batched `_iter_facts` loop in `query_patient` (rf_phasor_composer.py:1025-1026) both decode the (agent, action) role of EVERY composite actually present in `self.kb` via `_cleanup_all`/`unbind` (an argmax-over-vocabulary cleanup that indeed always returns *some* word) and then test `decoded_word == cue_value`. Because the comparand on one side is always a genuinely-stored fact's own decoded role — never a synthetic "nearest fact to the cue" — an unstored (agent, action) pair matches zero composites (mask all-False), `_scan_first_match` returns `idx=None`, and `query_patient` returns `None` before any rendering occurs (rf_phasor_composer.py:1005-1008). `query_chain` (rf_phasor_composer.py:1034-1047) and `ShardedPhasorStore.query_chain` (sharded_phasor_store.py:117-125) both call `query_patient` unconditionally per hop and break on `None`, so this None-propagation is inherited hop-for-hop for both the base composer and its sharded wrapper.
findings.manifests_as: N/A — this is a confirmation, not a defect. The no-confab moat at every hop holds as designed for the routing plan's target mechanism.
findings.mitigation: None required for this mechanism. (See the separate finding on cleanup-collision risk at larger fact counts, which is a distinct, probabilistic capacity concern rather than an architectural gap in the None-propagation itself.)

findings.failure_mode: Latent capacity/crosstalk scaling risk activated (not introduced) by this plan: the cleanup used inside every hop's cue-match scan has no confidence/similarity threshold — it is a pure argmax over the whole vocabulary — so as the 15k-fact LTM attachment and multi-hop chains are exercised together for the first time in production, the per-hop probability of an incidental cosine-similarity collision (a wrong stored composite's decoded agent/action happening to equal the cue by cross-talk rather than by a true match) is no longer negligible and compounds multiplicatively across a chain's hop count.
findings.mechanism: `_cleanup_all` (rf_phasor_composer.py:700-710) computes `sims = Re(rec_phasor @ conj(codebook)^T)` and takes `argmax` with no floor/margin check — the winning word is accepted regardless of how small its cosine margin over the runner-up is. `ShardedPhasorStore` (sharded_phasor_store.py:1-36) exists specifically because a flat 15k-fact scan is too slow, and reduces each query to ~K/S facts per shard, but does not touch this per-composite decode-confidence gap: each of the K/S composites scanned in `_scan_first_match` still has its agent/action cleaned up via unconditional argmax. A chain of N hops over a 15k-fact store performs N independent full-shard cue scans, each with its own (small but nonzero, and previously only de-risked at toy vocab sizes per the module's own 3-seed x 3-D GO note) chance of a spurious agent/action decode collision producing a false hop-match.
findings.code_location: research/runners/rf_phasor_composer.py:700-710 (_cleanup_all — no confidence/margin check) and :1034-1047 (query_chain, N sequential hops); research/runners/sharded_phasor_store.py:1-36 (module docstring: sharding addresses SCAN COST at 15k scale, not per-decode confidence)
findings.manifests_as: At production 15k-fact scale, a multi-hop chase could occasionally latch onto a wrong stored fact at some hop (a decode collision rather than a genuine relation match) and report a plausible but incorrect chain terminal, with no confidence signal distinguishing it from a correct hop — a class of error the small-vocabulary de-risk ("3 seeds x 3 D") cited in the query_chain docstring was not designed to bound.
findings.mitigation: Before shipping chain-of-thought over the full 15k-fact LTM, measure the per-hop cue-decode margin distribution at production K/vocab size and consider surfacing the `_cleanup_all_score_stats`/margin machinery (already built for the B3 trace, rf_phasor_composer.py:724-755) as a hop-level confidence check the chain can use to abstain on a low-margin hop rather than accepting any argmax winner.

findings.failure_mode: No token canonicalization exists anywhere on the recall path today, so the composer's codebook is a bag of literal surface strings — this is exactly the bug the plan is fixing, already caught live.
findings.mechanism: RFPhasorComposer.store() builds `fact = {"agent": agent, "action": action, "patient": patient}` from the caller's raw strings with zero normalization (no `.lower()`, no lemma call anywhere in the file — verified by grep). `self.concepts` (the codebook) is keyed by whatever literal string first reaches `_filler_phases`; an unseen string gets a fresh random phasor via the runtime-growth path. query_patient's fast path (`_scan_first_match`) requires the DECODED cue-role word to string-`==` the caller-supplied cue value — so 'hunts' (stored) vs 'hunt' (queried) are simply two different codebook entries that never compare equal.

findings.manifests_as: Documented live failure: teaching 'the wolf hunts the deer' then asking 'what does the wolf hunt?' abstains ('...I don't know about that.') even though the fact was just taught, and the SAME question later succeeds — an inconsistent, hard-to-reproduce recall bug (research/findings/2026-08-25-integrated-conversational-state-diagnostic.md:113-117). This is the ground-truth motivation for the lemmatization plan and confirms canonicalization is entirely absent today.
findings.mitigation: Confirms the plan direction is necessary; the remaining findings below are about doing it correctly rather than whether to do it.

findings.failure_mode: The repo already ships at least 6 mutually-inconsistent ad hoc 'lemmatizers' with different rules and different outputs on the same input — if store-time and query-time end up calling different ones (or different call sites reach for different ones), recall breaks asymmetrically and silently.
findings.mechanism: Concretely demonstrated divergence on the single input 'goes': `_emerge52_multilevel_conversational_console._lemma('goes')` checks the 'es'-after-sibilant rule (`w[-3] in "sxzo"`) and correctly returns 'go'. `b3_noncontradiction_production_organ._action_lemma_candidates('goes')` only ever strips a single trailing 's' (unless '-ss'), producing candidates `['goes', 'goe']` — 'go' is NEVER produced. `comprehension_production_organ._lemma_verb('goes')` is additionally gated on membership in a disjoint 8-verb `VERB_SELECTS` table and would leave 'goes' unchanged there. None of these three is imported by rf_phasor_composer.py or sharded_phasor_store.py today, so whichever one (or new one) the implementing agent wires into store vs. into the query/parse front-end (server.py's wh-question path, brain_conversational_agent.what_does, or a fresh helper) is a free choice with no existing enforcement that both sides agree.
findings.code_location: research/runners/_emerge52_multilevel_conversational_console.py:96-105 (_lemma); research/runners/b3_noncontradiction_production_organ.py:127-140 (_action_lemma_candidates); research/runners/comprehension_production_organ.py:119-144 (_lemma_verb/_lemma_noun); research/runners/argstructure_composer.py:92-96 (TENSE_3SG) + research/runners/wh_question_parser.py:77 (_INV_TENSE, present-tense-only, no past-tense coverage); research/runners/entity_instance_layer.py:66-79 (_PAST/past_tense, present-to-past, generation-direction); research/runners/first_chat_console.py:1413-1414 (an ad hoc, self.verbs-scoped inversion of _PAST, a THIRD independent normalization site)
findings.manifests_as: A fact stored via one code path's lemma rule and queried via another's silently returns None — indistinguishable from a genuine no-confab abstain (the moat's own success criterion), so the bug hides inside the honest-abstain UI exactly as the 'hunts'/'hunt' case did, and is very hard to catch in ad hoc testing because it depends on WHICH two call sites a given turn happens to exercise.
findings.mitigation: Land exactly ONE canonical lemmatizer module and import it at every store call site (RFPhasorComposer.store, ShardedPhasorStore.store) and every query/cue-extraction call site (query_patient, query_agent, ask_yes_no, query_chain's cue+actions, chain_of_thought, and every upstream parser in server.py/brain_conversational_agent.py/wh_question_parser.py that hands a role string to any of these). Add a same-PR test asserting the OLD ad hoc helpers (_lemma, _lemma_verb, _action_lemma_candidates, _INV_TENSE, past_to_pres) either agree with the new canonical function on a shared vocabulary or are deleted/deprecated, so silent divergence cannot recur.

findings.failure_mode: Over-merge: an unconditional, POS-blind irregular-form rewrite already exists in this codebase and will corrupt exactly the homograph classes named in the task (saw/see, left/leave, rose/rise) if the new lemmatizer follows the same pattern or runs before role/slot resolution.
findings.mechanism: `conjunctive_parser._IRREGULAR = {"saw": "see", "held": "hold", "eaten": "eat", ...}` is applied by `_normalize(tok, vocab)`, which rewrites ANY token equal to an `_IRREGULAR` key to its mapped base the moment the mapped base is present in the known vocabulary — it never checks whether the token was resolved to a NOUN slot or a VERB slot. Because RFPhasorComposer's codebook (`self.concepts`) is also a single global dict keyed by literal word regardless of role (rf_phasor_composer.py:301-316), a fact whose patient is the tool-noun 'saw' would collapse onto the same lemma/code as the verb 'see' the instant a lemmatizer of this shape is applied to a patient-slot token, or applied to raw text before role-parsing decides which slot a token fills.
findings.code_location: research/runners/conjunctive_parser.py:22-28 (_IRREGULAR table) and :36-48 (_normalize, vocab-gated but POS-blind substitution)
findings.manifests_as: 'The carpenter used the saw' (patient=saw, tool) taught, then queried honestly, silently returns the composer's cleaned-up answer for 'see' instead of abstaining or answering about the tool — a confabulation-adjacent corruption (two distinct facts fused into one key) the no-confab moat cannot catch because the store itself wrote the wrong key. The same mechanism threatens 'left' (direction/adjective) vs 'leave' (verb) and 'rose' (flower noun) vs 'rise' (verb) once both senses appear in the same growing vocabulary — increasingly likely once the 15k-entity LTM is attached, per the plan's own third rung.
findings.mitigation: Never rewrite a token before its grammatical ROLE is resolved by the parser; gate any verb-lemma table to tokens already placed in the action slot and any noun-lemma table to tokens already placed in agent/patient slots (mirroring comprehension_production_organ.py's existing _lemma_verb/_lemma_noun role-split — though finding 2 shows even that pair is not the one wired to the recall store). Before flipping the new lemmatizer default-on, run an explicit homograph regression battery (saw/see, left/leave, rose/rise, bears/bear) verifying both senses stay separately recallable.

findings.failure_mode: Under-merge: the repo's only broad irregular-verb table (35 entries) is wired to exactly ONE narrow, self.verbs-scoped consumer, and there is zero coverage anywhere for irregular noun plurals — so most natural irregular inflections the plan is meant to fix will remain unfixed.
findings.mechanism: `entity_instance_layer._PAST` (35 verbs: go/eat/see/run/come/give/take/make/find/have/chase/throw/say/feel/build/hear/sing/fly/become/put/sit/stand/hold/tell/get/leave/meet/fall/drink/swim/ride/write/draw/grow/know/fight) is defined for GENERATION (present-to-past rendering) and is only inverted, ad hoc, inside `first_chat_console._which_with_predicate` (`past_to_pres = {past_tense(v): v for v in self.verbs}`, first_chat_console.py:1413) — restricted to verbs the agent already happens to know at that moment. It is not imported by rf_phasor_composer.py, sharded_phasor_store.py, b3_noncontradiction_production_organ.py, or comprehension_production_organ.py. 'catch'/'caught' is absent from every table in the repo (grepped, zero hits). No irregular-noun-plural table ('mice'->'mouse', 'children'->'child') exists anywhere; `_lemma_noun` only strips a regular trailing 's'.
findings.code_location: research/runners/entity_instance_layer.py:66-79 (_PAST, generation-direction, 35 verbs); research/runners/first_chat_console.py:1413-1414 (the only inversion site, self.verbs-scoped); research/runners/comprehension_production_organ.py:139-144 (_lemma_noun, regular -s strip only, no irregular-plural table)
findings.manifests_as: 'The fox caught the mouse' stored, then 'what did the fox catch?' queried — abstains exactly like the documented hunts/hunt case, because neither 'caught'->'catch' nor 'mouse'/'mice' agreement is covered by any code path that actually runs on the store/query route. If the new plan's lemmatizer is (like most existing ones in this repo — finding 2) a regular-suffix-only stemmer, it will silently fix the easy regular cases (hunts/hunt, chases/chase) while leaving irregular cases — arguably the more natural, more frequent verbs a real conversation uses (ate, saw, caught, went) — exactly as broken as before, invisibly unless specifically tested.
findings.mitigation: Treat the irregular table as a first-class, explicitly-sized deliverable, not an implicit side effect of a regex stemmer: merge/reuse the existing _PAST + conjunctive_parser._IRREGULAR tables (deduplicated) as a floor, add a minimal irregular-noun-plural table, and CI-test recall on a fixed battery of irregular sentences (ate, caught, saw-as-verb, went, mice) so 'verb/noun lemmatize the recall path' is a measured claim. Any verb/noun outside the table should be a declared, named residual (matching this project's existing pattern in b3_noncontradiction_production_organ.py's own docstring) rather than a silent gap.

findings.failure_mode: ShardedPhasorStore.route() hashes the raw agent string for shard placement with no normalization of its own — lemmatization must happen upstream of every entry point into the class, or a correctly-canonicalized store and an inconsistently-canonicalized query land in different shards and can never see each other's facts.
findings.mechanism: `route(self, agent)` is `_stable_hash(agent) % self.n_shards` — a pure function of whatever string it is handed (sharded_phasor_store.py:93-96). `store()`, `query_patient()`, `ask_yes_no()`, `render_fact()`, `query_chain()`, and `chain_of_thought()` all call `self.shard_for(agent)` (i.e. `route(agent)`) directly on their agent/x argument with no internal canonicalization step (sharded_phasor_store.py:102-149). The class's own docstring assumes 'store and query use the SAME cue string' as the basis for its 'answer-identical to the unsharded store' guarantee (sharded_phasor_store.py:19-20) — an assumption lemmatization must satisfy, not one the class enforces.
findings.manifests_as: If the implementing agent puts the new lemmatizer inside RFPhasorComposer.store/query_patient but ShardedPhasorStore is called directly by some other production path without going through that wrapper's own normalization, a 'wolf'-keyed fact and a 'wolves'-keyed query would route to different shards and never meet — a failure that looks identical to a genuine unknown-agent abstain, at the routing layer, before any per-shard recall logic even runs.
findings.mitigation: Apply the canonical lemmatizer INSIDE ShardedPhasorStore's own store()/query_patient()/ask_yes_no()/render_fact()/query_chain()/chain_of_thought(), immediately before calling route()/shard_for(), so it cannot be bypassed by a caller — rather than relying on every external caller to canonicalize before calling in. This is specifically necessary for the noun-lemmatization half of the plan since routing pivots on the agent string at every hop.

findings.failure_mode: query_chain/chain_of_thought amplify any single lemmatization gap: because the moat's abstention fires the moment any hop has no matching fact, one un-lemmatized action string anywhere in a multi-hop chain silently kills the entire derived answer, and today's plain None gives no signal of which hop or why.
findings.mechanism: `query_chain(cue, actions)` calls `query_patient(x, action)` per hop and returns None the instant any hop misses (rf_phasor_composer.py:1034-1047; identically in sharded_phasor_store.py:117-125). `chain_of_thought` self-selects the next relation from `_relation_assoc()` (built from literal (agent, action) pairs seen in self.kb, rf_phasor_composer.py:1050-1061) and then calls the same query_patient hop (line 1105) — so an action string that was stored as 'hunts' but is looked up as 'hunt' (or vice versa) at ANY hop aborts the whole chain with the same generic abstain the moat uses for genuine unknowns. This is precisely the documented gap: after teaching (wolf,hunts,deer) and (deer,eats,grass), the compositional question 'what does the wolf's prey eat?' never even reaches chain_of_thought/query_chain yet (finding 2026-08-25, lines 118-122) — once wired, this hop-amplification becomes live.
findings.code_location: research/runners/rf_phasor_composer.py:1034-1047 (query_chain), :1078-1113 (chain_of_thought, hop at line 1105); research/runners/sharded_phasor_store.py:117-149 (identical sharded versions); research/findings/2026-08-25-integrated-conversational-state-diagnostic.md:118-122,158-166 (the plan's own motivating evidence)
findings.manifests_as: A natural multi-hop question ('what does the wolf's prey eat?') abstains not because the brain lacks the knowledge but because ONE of the two hops' verb forms (e.g. 'hunt' vs the stored 'hunts') mismatches — the user sees an honest-looking 'I don't know' that is actually a lemmatization bug, structurally indistinguishable from a true unknown-fact abstain without per-hop instrumentation, since the moat's abstain-on-any-miss design is intentionally conservative.
findings.mitigation: Lemmatize both the initial cue and every entry of `actions` (and, in chain_of_thought, the _relation_assoc keys) with the same canonical function used at store time, before the per-hop query_patient call. Extend the trace/activity payload (already present via last_trace, rf_phasor_composer.py:791-832) to record, on a chain abstain, which hop failed and the exact literal string that missed, so a lemmatization miss is distinguishable from a genuine unknown fact during rollout/testing.

result.key_uncertainty: This worktree contains no code for the actual lemmatizer yet (git status shows no new/modified file matching the plan; the wiring described is still at the finding/proposal stage in research/findings/2026-08-25-integrated-conversational-state-diagnostic.md). I could not determine which of the ~7 existing ad hoc morphology helpers the implementing agent intends to reuse versus writing fresh, and — most decisive for over- vs under-merge risk — whether the new lemmatizer will be applied AFTER role/slot resolution (POS-gated, as comprehension_production_organ.py's _lemma_verb/_lemma_noun split at least attempts) or applied token-blind before parsing (as conjunctive_parser.py's _IRREGULAR/_normalize does). That single design choice determines whether the dominant risk in practice is over-merge (homograph corruption) or under-merge (irregulars left broken); whoever lands the diff must resolve it explicitly rather than by default.

hardening_requirements: ROUTE EACH HOP THROUGH chat.gate, NOT a raw composer.query_chain / ShardedPhasorStore.query_chain call. Verified: the deliberation conflict-abstain lives in the gate wrapper via all_candidate_patients (gnw_deliberation.py:122-134); query_chain's per-hop query_patient instead silently takes _scan_first_match's FIRST match (rf_phasor_composer.py:721 `return int(idx[0])`). A direct composer call — which the plan's literal wording says — bypasses the entire GNW consensus/comprehension/conflict stack. A hop whose (agent,action) has >=2 distinct stored patients MUST abstain the whole chain (the single-hop path would say 'I don't know'), never march through an arbitrary first-match.

ADD A PER-HOP CONFIDENCE FLOOR to the abstain gate — the moat is exact-string-equality-gated, NOT confidence-gated (rf_phasor_composer.py:719 `mask &= (w == val)`; _cleanup at 658-663 always returns the argmax word, no None). Replace the bare `w == val` with `w == val AND winner_score_raw >= tau AND margin >= delta` using the already-computed _cleanup_all_score_stats (724-755, currently trace-only). Gate BOTH cue roles (agent, action) AND the answer decode (patient/attribute at 1010-1012) so a thin-margin crosstalk near-miss abstains (returns None) instead of emitting the nearest word. Calibrate tau/delta from the same-vs-different distribution the code already builds (_calibrate_pe_labile, 870-889).

MEASURE, before trusting the route, the per-hop cue-decode FALSE-POSITIVE rate (a wrong-agent fact whose agent+action both crosstalk-decode onto an IN-VOCAB query word) and the wrong-patient decode rate at the DEPLOYED D=128 (tiered_fact_store.py:65 / developed_brain_io.py:369) and 15k-fact / real-vocab scale. The existing '0 confabulations' evidence (_knowledge_scale_flip_soak.py:174-188) only probes UNSTORED cues that abstain STRUCTURALLY; it never stresses in-vocab near-misses. If nonzero, raise D (faithfulness > speed). This is the single number the floor-less gate's safety rests on.

FRAME A DERIVED ANSWER AS DERIVED, NOT PERCEIVED. The #129 wire hardcodes PROVENANCE_PERCEIVED (webapp/server.py:5164-5175) under an invariant comment (5154-5156) that a chain route breaks. Encode PROVENANCE_GENERATED so provenance_framed_text (source_provenance_honesty.py:120-134) emits the 'my own inference' framing, surface the supporting hop-facts ('I derived this from <fact1> and <fact2>'), and fix the now-false invariant comment. Reusing the PERCEIVED wire verbatim inverts the plan's own honest-derivation goal into a provenance lie.

GIVE A DERIVED ANSWER A DISTINCT API SHAPE AND KEEP IT OUT OF EPISODIC MEMORY. verified='[unverified render' not in answer (server.py:5148-5150) only checks the SURFACE re-parses — NOT that the triple is stored — so a synthesized terminal (precedent: gnw_multistep_deliberation.py out[2]=terminal) reports verified=true / recalled_svo=[wolf,eat,grass] indistinguishably from a real recall. Set recalled_svo=None (or derived_from=[[a,v,p]...]) + derived:true, and do NOT feed the synthesized terminal SVO into note_topic (server.py:5181-5184) or the discourse-WM referent write (brain_chat_tui.py:380-382). Verify each HOP-fact (each is stored), not the composed terminal.

FIX THE EXTRACTION TRUNCATION FIRST — run compositional detection + relation-sequence extraction on the FULL stopword-stripped content list BEFORE _extract_route's two-word collapse. _neural_question_parse pads to `[content[0], content[1], '__q__']` (brain_chat_tui.py:652) and never reads content[2]+, and _STOP (696-698) deletes 'of' and does not split possessive 's, so 'what does the wolf's prey eat?' loses the verb 'eat' before any chain logic runs. Treat 's and 'of' as structural relation markers, not stopwords. Any detector bolted on AFTER this collapse cannot work.

LAND EXACTLY ONE CANONICAL, ROLE-GATED LEMMATIZER applied to BOTH store and query sides. result.moat_verdict: SAFE-WITH-FIXES. The per-hop no-confab moat is preserved BY CONSTRUCTION for genuinely-unknown cues: query_chain (rf_phasor_composer.py:1034-1047) returns None the instant any hop's query_patient returns None, and that None comes from _scan_first_match (712-721), which decodes the (agent,action) roles of every TRULY-STORED composite and matches them by EXACT STRING EQUALITY (`w == val`, line 719) against the queried pair. Because the nearest-neighbour cleanup (_cleanup, 658-663; always returns the argmax word, never None) is applied to recover a STORED value and then compared for equality against the cue — not thresholded on the cue itself — a 'cleanup always returns something' argmax cannot by itself fabricate a matching hop, and an out-of-vocab subject can never be matched at all. So routing natural compositional questions to query_chain is genuinely moat-safe for real unknowns — this is a strength, not a hole. BUT the gate has NO minimum-similarity floor, so its entire safety rests on ONE load-bearing, currently-UNMEASURED condition: the rate at which, at the deployed D=128 / 15k-fact / real-vocab scale, FHRR bundling crosstalk pushes a wrong-agent fact's decoded agent+action onto an in-vocab query word (a false hop) — which the chain then LAUNDERS into a confident multi-hop answer with no low-confidence signal, since every intermediate is re-discretised to a clean codebook word. The existing '0 confabulations' evidence never tested this (it probed only UNSTORED cues that abstain structurally). Secondarily, the plan's literal wording — 'call ShardedPhasorStore.query_chain directly' — would bypass the GNW deliberation conflict-abstain (a multi-valued hop that the single-hop path withholds) and reuse the hardcoded PROVENANCE_PERCEIVED wire (server.py:5164-5175), asserting an inference as a taught, 'verified' fact. The single load-bearing condition is therefore: the per-hop cue+answer decode must carry a confidence floor (reuse the already-computed _cleanup_all_score_stats margin) with the near-miss false-positive rate measured and driven to zero at deployed scale, AND each hop must pass through chat.gate's conflict-abstain and be framed as GENERATED — with those in place the route is moat-clean; without them it is a moat bypass.

missed_failure_modes: SUPPORTED-HOP WRONG-PATIENT/ATTRIBUTE DECODE (the channel the verdict wrongly calls laundered-safe). _render returns a bare _cleanup(rec) argmax (rf_phasor_composer.py:557) and the attribute decode is a bare unbind (query_patient:1011) — NEITHER has an equality check against ground truth NOR a floor. The moat's equality gate (_scan_first_match w==val, :719) touches ONLY the cue roles, never the answer. So a hop whose (agent,action) genuinely match a real fact can still return the WRONG stored patient via codebook crosstalk against the large 15k-vocab codebook: a confident wrong terminal that is NOT an out-of-vocab confab and is invisible to every equality-based moat. Re-discretisation to a clean codebook word is exactly what HIDES this, not what prevents it.

MULTI-VALUED HOPS ARE THE COMMON CASE ON A 15k BULK LTM, NOT AN EDGE CASE. A corpus stores the same (agent,action) with many patients ('dog eat X' from many sentences), so _scan_first_match's idx[0] (rf_phasor_composer.py:721) — kb-INSERTION-ORDER first-match — silently picks an arbitrary patient at potentially every hop. A direct ShardedPhasorStore.query_chain bypasses the single-hop deliberation abstain (all_candidate_patients, gnw_deliberation.py:122-134). The spec treats deliberation-bypass as a corner fix; at LTM scale it is a HIGH-FREQUENCY correctness hazard, and the chain answer becomes INSERTION-ORDER dependent (load() preserves order but a re-ingest in a different order flips the terminal) = a determinism hazard.

STORE-IDENTITY / MULTI-TURN REACHABILITY. 'Attach the 15k LTM to the default brain' leaves unspecified whether in-session hear() facts and the LTM live in ONE queryable store. If the LTM is a separate ShardedPhasorStore, a chain needing one just-taught hop + one LTM hop cannot resolve (the taught fact isn't in the LTM store; the LTM fact isn't in inner.composer), and a fact taught 5 turns ago — past the discourse-WM window (brain_chat_tui.py:758-764) — may be unreachable. No requirement pins the single-store invariant the chain silently assumes.

INVERSE-DIRECTION RELATION-NOUNS. query_chain is AGENT-pivot FORWARD only (patient becomes next agent). 'the wolf's prey' happens to be forward-aligned (patient of hunt), but 'the deer's predator / X's employer / X's parent' need the AGENT of (?,rel,X) = a reverse query_agent that fans out ALL shards (sharded_phasor_store.py:152-169) — query_chain cannot express it and will mis-hop or abstain. Neither a hardening requirement nor a test covers inverse possessives; the battery's one relation-noun ('prey') is the lucky forward case.

DOWNSTREAM COUPLINGS RE-INFLATE A DERIVED ANSWER. server.py appends a da_drives suffix (:5130-5131) and prepends world-model/surprise/reconsolidation/pragmatic (:5191-5193) plus a metacog hedge (:5195+). The metacog reads _read_activity() = the LAST substrate op's confidence, which for a 4-hop chain reflects only the final hop — mislabeling a compounded chain's confidence. An affect/DA suffix can also make a GENERATED-framed inference read MORE confident, fighting provenance_framed_text's 'I reasoned that myself' frame (source_provenance_honesty.py:134-137). No requirement orders provenance/metacog to dominate the affect wrappers for derived answers.

LATENCY OF A 4-HOP CHAIN IN THE LIVE LOOP. Each hop = a full RF resonate + a (K_shard x V) codebook cleanup (_cleanup_all) + a V-word answer cleanup, run SYNCHRONOUSLY in /api/brain-chat. A 4-hop chain is ~4x that at deployed 15k/real-V. No requirement sets a per-turn latency budget or a hop-cap/timeout; the orchestration-latency wall is the project's known real-time bottleneck, so a multi-second chain blocks the handler.

PARSER-DECLINE PRE-EMPTS THE CHAIN. _extract_route returns '__DECLINE__' -> '__ABSTAIN__' when the on-brain BridgeParser cannot role-assign a >=2-content-word question (brain_chat_tui.py:716-719), and the has_self_alias gate (:714) diverts too. A genuinely compositional 3+word question can hit this abstain BEFORE any chain detector runs. Hardening #6 fixes the two-word pad truncation (:652) but not this SECOND abstain gate.
battery_gaps: Hardening #2's ANSWER-ROLE floor is UNTESTED. No scenario teaches a SUPPORTED hop and asserts the patient/attribute decode returns the true stored value (or abstains on a thin margin) at 15k scale — every confab scenario probes UNSUPPORTED hops that abstain structurally. The supported-hop-wrong-patient channel (_render:557 bare argmax) has no battery test. (The soak's single-hop recall_rate exists but is not in the battery and is not chain-level.)

Hardening #3 demands a false-positive RATE across MANY in-vocab near-miss cues; the battery offers ONE hand-built near-miss (scenario 2: 'fox eat' with a chase fact). A single passing example is not a rate. No swept-cue rate-measurement item exists, so the one number the floor-less gate's safety rests on is never actually produced by the battery.

Hardening #10's GRADED confidence has no test. No scenario checks that an all-supported-but-THIN-MARGIN long chain returns a LOW-CONFIDENCE HEDGE (as opposed to a bare confident answer). The over-run scenario tests abstain-on-deadend, not hedge-on-degraded-but-complete.

No LATENCY or DETERMINISM test: no 4-hop wall-clock budget at deployed 15k/real-V, and no chain insertion-order-independence test on a multi-valued (agent,action) hop (the idx[0] first-match, rf_phasor_composer.py:721).

No MULTI-TURN / SINGLE-STORE test: a chain mixing an in-session-taught hop with an LTM hop, or a chain over a fact taught 5 turns ago (past the discourse-WM window), is never exercised — the chain scenarios teach both facts in the same turn.

No INVERSE-RELATION-POSSESSIVE test ('what does the deer's predator eat?'). The battery's relation-noun coverage is the single forward-aligned 'prey', so an agent-direction possessive that query_chain cannot express is uncaught.

No DOWNSTREAM-COUPLING test: that the DA suffix / affect+surprise prefixes / metacog hedge do not re-inflate a GENERATED-framed derived answer, and that metacog confidence reflects the whole chain rather than only the last hop's _read_activity().
result.verdict_check: The verdict's core is CORRECT and well-grounded, not alarmist: for genuinely-unknown out-of-vocab cues the moat holds by construction — verified that _scan_first_match matches by exact string equality of a DECODED STORED cue against the query (rf_phasor_composer.py:719 `w == val`), _cleanup always returns an argmax word (:658-663) but is COMPARED to the cue rather than thresholded on it, so an out-of-vocab subject can never match. The verdict is slightly TOO OPTIMISTIC in ONE structural way: it names a SINGLE unmeasured load-bearing condition (the cue-role false-hop crosstalk rate) and explicitly treats the answer decode as laundered-safe ('every intermediate is re-discretised to a clean codebook word'). But re-discretisation is exactly what HIDES a supported-hop WRONG-PATIENT misrecall — _render returns a bare argmax with no equality check against ground truth (:557) — so there are TWO unmeasured load-bearing rates at deployed scale, not one: the cue-role false-hop rate AND the answer/attribute-role misrecall rate, and the second is arguably LIKELIER to bite because a 15k LTM guarantees a large answer codebook and many supported hops. It also under-weights that multi-valued (agent,action) hops are the COMMON case on a bulk LTM (so the deliberation-bypass is frequent, not a corner case) and leaves the single-store-reachability and bounded-chain-latency assumptions unstated. Corrected: SAFE-WITH-FIXES, but the load-bearing unmeasured surface is TWO decode rates (cue AND answer/attribute) at D=128/15k/real-V, the deliberation conflict-abstain must be inherited on what will be a HIGH-FREQUENCY multi-valued-hop path, and safety additionally rests on an unstated single-store reachability invariant and a bounded per-turn chain latency.
